name: City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, February 25, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special and Regular City Council Meetings held on February 11, 2015
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item 7B
c.
Resolution 2015-10, Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item 7C
d.
Consideration of Amendment No. 1 with Black & Veatch to prepare a Water Rate Study
ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 1 with Black and Veatch increasing the contract by $2,000.
Item 7D
e.
Notice of Completion (NOC) and release of the 10% retention payment in the amount of $17,700.53 to Omega Contractors for the installation of rubberized safety playground surfacing at Lomita Park, CIP Project No. 125
ACTION: 1) Accept the work performed by Omega Contractors;
2)
Authorize the City Clerk to file the attached NOC with the County Recorder's Office; and
3)
Authorize the Director of Parks and Recreation to sign the NOC and release the 10% retention payment in the amount of $17,700.52 to Omega Contractors, 35 calendar days after recordation of the NOC by the County Recorder's Office contingent upon no claims being filed on the project and the contractor posting an acceptable warranty bond.
Item 7E
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
Discussion and Acceptance of the City's Audit Report for Fiscal Year 2013-3014. ACTION: To receive and file the Fiscal Year 2013-2014 Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR).
Presented by Ron Lopez, Gruber and Associates
Item 8
9.
Approval of 2015 Founder's Day Event for June 27, 2015. ACTION: The Founder's Day sub-committee recommends the Council direct staff to plan, organize and implement the 2015 Founder's Day Event for June 27, 2015.
Item 9
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
10.
AN ORDINANCE AMENDING SECTION 11-1.51.02(A)(30) OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE PERMITTING RETAIL CIGAR OR TOBACCO SALES WITH OR WITHOUT ACCESSORY SMOKING LOUNGES WITHIN THE MC (LIGHT MANUFACTURING COMMERCIAL) ZONE ONLY Staff recommends that the City Council, after City Attorney reads the title:
1)
Introduce on first reading an Ordinance amending Section 11-1.51.02(A)(30) of the Lomita Municipal Code permitting retail cigar or tobacco sales with or without accessory smoking lounges within the MC (Light Manufacturing Commercial) Zone only;
2)
Accept the categorical exemption for the project; and
3)
Direct staff to schedule the second reading and adoption of the ordinance for the March 11, 2015 City Council meeting .
Item 10
11.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be on March 11, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
